module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  train_valid,
    input  train_taken,
    output reg [1:0] state
);

    // State register
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) begin
            state <= 2'b01; // Reset to weakly not-taken
        end else begin
            if (train_valid) begin
                if (train_taken) begin
                    // Increment up to max 3 (2'b11)
                    if (state < 2'b11) begin
                        state <= state + 1;
                    end
                end else begin
                    // Decrement down to min 0 (2'b00)
                    if (state > 2'b00) begin
                        state <= state - 1;
                    end
                end
            end
            // else: no change
        end
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  train_valid,
    input  train_taken,
    output reg [1:0] state
);

    // Saturating counter logic
    always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
        if (areset) begin
            state <= 2'b01; // Reset to weakly not-taken (2'b01)
        end else begin
            if (train_valid) begin
                if (train_taken) begin
                    if (state < 2'b11) begin
                        state <= state + 1;
                    end
                end else begin
                    if (state > 2'b00) begin
                        state <= state - 1;
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  load,
    input  ena,
    input  data,
    output q
);

// Internal signals
reg [99:0] reg_q;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (load) begin
        reg_q <= data;
    end else begin
        case (ena)
            2'b01: reg_q <= {reg_q[98:0], reg_q[99]}; // Rotate right
            2'b10: reg_q <= {reg_q[0], reg_q[98:1]};  // Rotate left
            default: reg_q <= reg_q;                  // No rotation
        endcase
    end
end

assign q = reg_q;

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input      cpu_overheated,
    output reg shut_off_computer,
    input      arrived,
    input      gas_tank_empty,
    output reg keep_driving
);

    always @(*) begin
        if (cpu_overheated) begin
            shut_off_computer = 1;
        end else begin
            shut_off_computer = 0;
        end
    end

    always @(*) begin
        if (~arrived) begin
            keep_driving = ~gas_tank_empty;
        end else begin
            keep_driving = 0;
        end
    end

endmodule
